ui.tagline: A little practice. A lifetime of music.
ui.welcomeBody: Build your musical intuition, one small discovery at a time. Read it, hear it, play it.
ui.courseBody: A clear path from your first sound to your first melody.
ui.quickBody: Listen closely. Follow the melody. Find your way around the keys.
ui.local: Your progress stays in this browser. No account needed.
ui.scoreBody: Follow the highlighted notes on the staff and the piano.
ui.audioError: Audio could not start. Try Play again.
ui.noAudio: This browser does not support Web Audio.
ui.audioFallback: A sample could not load. Synthesized preview is active.
ui.pianoHint: Play with touch or mouse. Computer keys A W S E D F T G Y H U J K play C4–C5. Arrow keys move piano focus; Enter or Space plays.
ui.exerciseBody: Which piano key matches the note on this staff? Play a key or choose its name below.
ui.incorrect: Not quite. The written note is
ui.exerciseHint: Read from the clef reference and count lines and spaces.
ui.progressBody: A record of your curiosity, practice and steady progress.
ui.resetConfirm: Delete all learning progress saved in this browser?
ui.emptyProgress: Your first discovery is waiting. Start a lesson to begin your record.
ui.convention: Pitch notation: middle C = C4 · A4 = 440 Hz · equal temperament
ui.practiceBody: Slow down. Listen again. Let the notes become familiar.
ui.tryWithoutStorage: Browser storage is unavailable. Progress will last only for this visit.
ui.practiceTip: Five focused minutes today can make tomorrow’s notes feel familiar.
ui.libraryTitle: A classical repertoire to grow with.
ui.libraryBody: 50 works and teaching studies, from first guided steps to early-intermediate consolidation. Difficulty is our teaching estimate, not an official exam grade.
ui.libraryNotice: Open a study edition for synchronized playback where available, or the original PDF. Duet difficulty refers to the student part; teacher accompaniment can be harder. New transcriptions await independent note-by-note review.
ui.harmonyBody: Build chords, compare inversions and follow original study notes from triads to modulation. Begin with staff reading, intervals and major/minor scales.
ui.harmonyNote: The explorer plays simultaneous chord tones. The study tasks are open questions for practice; they do not award mastery scores.
ui.importTitle: Read a score. Hear every voice.
ui.importBody: Import an uncompressed MusicXML score to study its voices, ties and repeats. Review the feature report before playing. Practice tempo is always measured in quarter notes per minute.
ui.chooseMusicXML: Choose MusicXML (.musicxml or .xml, up to 2 MiB)
ui.importPrivacy: The selected file stays in this browser. It is not uploaded. Compressed MXL, DTDs and external resources are not accepted.
ui.importError: This score could not be opened.
ui.unsupportedScore: Playback is unavailable for this score or setting. Review unsupported features, ties and the 88-key range.
ui.engravingError: The score could not be engraved. Try a smaller MusicXML file.
ui.transposeNotice: The staff keeps the original written pitches; the transposition control shifts only the sound and piano keys. Instrument transposition is applied separately.
ui.tuningNotice: Historical-ratio demonstration anchored to C4 = 261.63 Hz. This is not adaptive tuning for every key, and A4 may differ from 440 Hz.
ui.issue-xml-dtd: DTD and entity declarations are not accepted. Export MusicXML without a DTD.
ui.issue-xml-root: Use an uncompressed score-partwise MusicXML file.
ui.issue-practice-tempo: Printed tempo marks remain visible. Playback uses the selected constant practice tempo.
ui.issue-expression-playback: Pedal and gradual dynamic markings are displayed but are not interpreted in playback.
ui.issue-ornament-playback: Ornaments and technical markings remain visible. Their realization is not synthesized.
ui.issue-measure-duration: Some measures differ from their stated meter. Check pickups, incomplete bars or the source transcription.
ui.issue-part-alignment: Parts do not align in measure count or duration. Playback is blocked.
ui.issue-jumps: D.C., D.S. and coda jumps require a checked execution route. Playback is blocked.
ui.issue-octave-shift: Octave-shift directions require explicit realization. Playback is blocked.
ui.issue-grace-playback: Grace-note timing requires interpretation. Playback is blocked.
ui.issue-unpitched: Unpitched instruments cannot be played on the piano.
ui.issue-polymeter: Simultaneous different meters are not supported in playback.
ui.instrumentBody: Connect a MIDI keyboard or explore one sustained note with the microphone. Manual piano input remains available.
ui.midiBody: Play with velocity and sustain pedal. Releasing focus, disconnecting a device or pressing All notes off stops held voices. MIDI requires browser support and an explicit connection.
ui.noMidiDevice: MIDI enabled; no input device connected.
ui.midiUnavailable: Web MIDI is unavailable. Use a compatible browser over HTTPS or the manual piano.
ui.midiError: MIDI access was denied or the connection failed.
ui.micBody: Play or sing one clear sustained note. Audio is analyzed locally and is neither recorded nor uploaded. Stop releases the microphone; hiding or leaving the window also stops capture.
ui.listeningPitch: Listening for a stable single pitch…
ui.micCaution: This is an estimate, not an exercise grade. Noise, multiple notes and strong overtones can cause octave or pitch errors. Supported estimate range: 80–1200 Hz.
ui.micUnavailable: Microphone capture is unavailable. Use HTTPS and a supported browser.
ui.micError: Microphone access failed or was denied.
ui.fullCourseTitle: From the first staff to advanced ideas.
ui.fullCourseBody: 58 original chapter-linked study notes, grouped by topic. Read freely, practice construction and complete a varied review round. Reading and demonstrated answers are tracked separately.
ui.reviewRoundBody: Each round draws ten different questions from the course. Eight correct answers meet the practice threshold for that round; this does not certify overall musical proficiency.
ui.roundPassed: Practice threshold reached for this round.
ui.roundPractice: Review the explanations and try another round.
ui.constructionBody: Enter fixed-do or letter names separated by spaces. Octaves are optional. Scales require ascending order; chord tones may be reordered. Spelling matters, except that whole-tone scales accept enharmonic spellings.
ui.intervalBody: Count written letter names first; then compare semitone distance with the major or perfect baseline. Enharmonic fourths and fifths can sound alike while retaining different interval names.
ui.accountBody: Learning works without an account. Export a local backup or choose an optional account to save and restore progress on another device.
ui.restoreConfirm: Replace this browser’s learning progress with the selected backup? Export your current progress first if you want to keep it.
ui.accountPolicy: Use a unique handle (3–32 letters, digits or underscores) and a password of 12–256 characters. No email is collected; password recovery by email is unavailable. Keep your password and a local backup.
ui.signedIn: Signed in. Your local progress has not been replaced.
ui.syncPolicy: Save uploads this browser’s snapshot. Restore downloads the latest cloud snapshot after confirmation. A conflicting server version blocks overwriting: restore or review the latest version before saving again. Snapshots are not silently merged.
ui.deleteAccountConfirm: Permanently delete this account and its cloud snapshot? Browser-local progress will remain.
ui.accountDeleted: Account and cloud progress deleted. Local progress remains.
ui.account-invalid-progress: The progress backup is invalid, unsupported or too large.
ui.account-invalid-account: Check the handle and password requirements.
ui.account-handle-unavailable: This handle cannot be registered. Choose another.
ui.account-invalid-credentials: The handle or password is incorrect.
ui.account-progress-conflict: A newer cloud version exists. Restore or review it before saving again.
ui.account-account-rate: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
ui.account-signed-out: Sign in to access cloud progress.
ui.account-account-error: The account request could not be completed. Try again.
ui.nativeStudyNotice: Study edition engraved from the licensed source, with repeats written out. Follow the sounding notes and keys. Compare interpretation and ornaments with the original PDF.
ui.nativeUnavailable: This study edition is unavailable or failed its integrity check. Rebuild the score assets and try again.
ui.issue-nested-repeat: Nested repeat signs are not supported. Unfold this passage before importing.
ui.nativeStudentPart: This edition includes only the student primo, with both hands. Teacher accompaniment, historical fingerings and phrase slurs are omitted.
ui.nativeNewTranscription: New study transcription: notes and rhythm require independent comparison with the linked PDF. Historical fingerings and phrase slurs are omitted.
